inputs.text: [breathing heavily] [angry] You recognized it. Don't tell me to watch my feet. I am watching my feet, and I'm asking you what that mark is.
[nervous] [voice trembling] It's a Malfoy ward. I thought it was dead. I didn't think there was anything left that could do this.
[angry] [raising voice] Your family's magic is firing arrows at us, and you were going to wait until when to tell me? Until another one missed?
[defensive] [voice breaking] I recognized it just now. You saw me recognize it. Don't turn that into me knowing everything before you walked into the room.
